description: The Wavex Super Plush Edgeless Buffing Towel is designed for enthusiasts and professional detailers who want the safest way to wipe and buff their vehicle. Made with premium high-GSM microfiber, this towel provides exceptional softness and absorbency while protecting delicate automotive paint surfaces. The edgeless laser-cut design eliminates stitched borders, reducing the risk of swirl marks or scratches during buffing. This towel is ideal for removing wax, polishing compounds, sealants, ceramic coatings and detailing sprays, leaving behind a flawless and streak-free finish. Its plush microfiber fibers effectively trap product residue and dust while remaining lint-free and gentle on paintwork. Whether you're doing a final buff after polishing, removing wax haze, or wiping down your vehicle with a quick detailer, this towel provides professional-grade performance.
